source: Owner-provided 220-topic list supplied in the VLP project conversation on 2026-10-19.
translation_note: English titles are a convenience translation. The original Russian title is preserved; clarification does not silently rewrite it.
status_note: These are research and design topics, not 220 approved normative requirements or implemented features.
closure_rule: Resolution requires a reviewed decision reference, evidence, scope/disposition, specification coverage, and remaining risks. Deferred or excluded features remain in the register with reasons. No record is resolved by this foundation change.

planning_tracks.meaning: Research a required design topic; no design or implementation is approved.
Evaluate alternatives or optional capabilities and record the scope decision.
Specify the property now; implementation work remains behind its approval gate.
Plan evidence now; execute only at the authorized stage and record actual results.
Track document coverage; formal specifications follow the Research Gate.

records.original_title_ru: Самостоятельный протокол или расширение существующего транспорта.
records.title_en: Independent protocol or extension of an existing transport.
records.clarification: A protocol over QUIC can still be a distinct protocol. A native UDP transport adds responsibilities and needs a recorded justification.

records.original_title_ru: Модель взаимодействия клиент — сервер — узел — узел.
records.clarification: Define roles, trust boundaries, relays, and key-termination endpoints; node-to-node interaction is not automatically a P2P topology.
P2P is a scope candidate; discovery, admission, NAT traversal, relay fallback, and peer privacy need a joint decision.

records.original_title_ru: Архитектура Control Plane и Data Plane.
records.title_en: Control Plane and Data Plane architecture.

records.clarification: TCP carriage requires an explicit mapping of stream/datagram semantics and a review of head-of-line blocking and fallback policy.

records.original_title_ru: Собственный механизм надёжной доставки поверх UDP.
records.title_en: A protocol-specific reliable-delivery mechanism over UDP.
records.clarification: If an existing reliable carrier is selected, justify any additional reliability layer instead of duplicating it automatically.
Distinguish multiplexed application channels from separate transport connections; ownership and limits must remain explicit.

The original wording is preserved. Resending a cached, byte-identical encoded packet is distinct from encrypting a new packet. A new AEAD encryption must satisfy the selected construction's nonce-uniqueness rules, even when the plaintext is unchanged; changing authenticated headers does not permit reuse of the same key/nonce pair. Specify how retransmitted logical data receives fresh packet numbers and nonces.
Bound fragment count, total reassembly memory, lifetime, and pre-authentication work. Decide whether fragmentation is required for the selected IP profile.
NAT rebinding, hole punching, ICE-style traversal, discovery, and relays are different mechanisms; select only the applicable ones.
Separate migration with one active path from simultaneous multipath; review congestion fairness and packet-number/key contexts.

records.original_title_ru: Управление задержками, джиттером и пропускной способностью.

records.clarification: State whose compromise is considered, when it occurs, which data is protected, and which secrets must have been erased.

records.original_title_ru: Post-Compromise Security — восстановление защищённости после компрометации.
records.clarification: A one-way update derived from a compromised traffic secret does not by itself restore secrecy. Specify attacker access, fresh secret contributions, and identity-key recovery.
A post-quantum primitive does not imply an authenticated post-quantum protocol. Evaluate the complete profile and its threat assumptions.

records.original_title_ru: Гибридный классический и постквантовый обмен ключами.
records.title_en: Hybrid classical and post-quantum key exchange.
records.clarification: Review the exact hybrid construction, transcript binding, identity authentication, confirmation, size, and fragmentation requirements.
Nonce namespaces must account for directions, generations, retries, paths, restarts, and snapshot restoration.
No network failure, migration, or restored snapshot may silently reset a counter under a reused key.
Specify implementation and platform limits; do not promise universal erasure of registers, copies, swap, or crash dumps.
A protocol-specific handshake specification may integrate an existing reviewed construction; this is not a requirement to invent new cryptography.
Record whether mutual authentication is mandatory for the initial use case, rather than assuming that every optional mode is equivalent.
Authentication modes are alternatives requiring explicit policy. A failed stronger mode must not silently select a weaker mode.
Separate PSKs, identifiers, public keys, certificates, enrollment credentials, and authorization; one mode need not support all others.
Keep the mandatory initial profile small and bind any negotiation to authenticated context.
Early application data is a scope decision with replay and side-effect analysis; planning 0-RTT is not permission to enable it.
Define ticket/key lifecycle, peer identity, replay handling, expiry, and multi-node state before introducing resumption.
Obfuscation is not payload confidentiality, authentication, or evidence of indistinguishability.
Randomize only permitted values. Authentication, parse bounds, protocol invariants, and negotiated minimum policy still apply.

records.original_title_ru: Согласованность внешнего поведения с выбранным транспортом.
records.title_en: Consistency of observable behavior with the selected transport.
records.clarification: A native UDP format with a similar prefix is not a standards-compliant HTTP/3 carrier. Specify each profile honestly.

records.original_title_ru: Анализ корреляции входящих и исходящих потоков.
records.clarification: State observer placement and capabilities; a successful classifier experiment does not establish global unlinkability.

records.original_title_ru: Баланс маскировки, задержки и накладных расходов.
records.clarification: Count padding, headers, control traffic, and retransmissions in applicable network and resource budgets.
A packet number is distinct from a stream offset or message ID; define its scope and authenticated interpretation.
Define sequence-number purpose and namespace; do not introduce a redundant counter without a semantic need.
Frame-level and packet-level protection are design alternatives or explicitly composed layers, not a requirement for redundant encryption.
Transport acknowledgment does not prove application processing or exactly-once execution across reconnections.

records.title_en: Separation of data and control messages.

records.clarification: A client-provided priority is a request. The enforcing peer determines its allowed class and resource share.

records.original_title_ru: Защита от изменения порядка сообщений, если это критично.
records.title_en: Protection of message ordering where required.
records.clarification: Ordering is required only for the negotiated semantics; an unreliable datagram profile must not silently become a reliable stream.
Validate return reachability and bound responses; account for retry and camouflage bytes before authentication.

records.original_title_ru: Защита от DoS на уровне протокола.

records.clarification: Security-policy failure must not disable authentication. Dropping one unauthenticated forged packet must not let an outsider terminate a valid session.

records.original_title_ru: Защита от некорректных и специально сформированных пакетов.
Предотвращение утечек через сообщения об ошибках.

records.clarification: Recovery must preserve identity and authorization and avoid restoring traffic secrets with lost nonce/replay state.

records.original_title_ru: Сокрытие идентичности участников там, где это возможно.
records.clarification: Specify identity-disclosure properties for each handshake flight, including future compromise of long-lived keys.
Connection IDs route packets; possession of an ID is not authentication. Rotation alone does not remove all linkability.

records.original_title_ru: Политика обработки DNS, если протокол передаёт имена.
records.title_en: DNS handling policy when names are carried.
records.clarification: If names are carried, decide who resolves them, trust and egress policy, destination disclosure, and handling of address changes.
Distinguish application recovery, reconnection, transport resumption, and restore from a local snapshot.

records.original_title_ru: Защита от подмены адреса при миграции.
Обработка потери пакетов и недоступности узла.
records.title_en: Packet loss and peer unavailability handling.

records.clarification: Measure cryptographic establishment separately from channel acceptance and application readiness.
Zero-copy is an implementation option, not a wire-level security or correctness guarantee.

records.original_title_ru: Работа в сетях с низкой пропускной способностью.

records.clarification: A separate wire-version scheme is a candidate; minimize independent version axes and bind compatibility negotiation.
Compatibility must not keep a prohibited security mode usable after retirement.
Algorithm agility requires authenticated negotiation and a clear minimum policy; it is not trial-and-error fallback.
Differentiate ignorable extensions from mandatory unknown semantics and bound parsing work.

records.original_title_ru: Защита от бесконечных циклов повторной передачи.
Сравнение с VLESS, Shadowsocks, Hysteria 2, WireGuard, AmneziaWG, QUIC, TLS 1.3 и Noise.
records.title_en: Comparison with VLESS, Shadowsocks, Hysteria 2, WireGuard, AmneziaWG, QUIC, TLS 1.3, and Noise.
records.clarification: Compare like-for-like functions and configurations: proxy protocols, transports, cryptographic frameworks, and applications are different layers.
Later vectors must be synthetic, versioned, and cover negative cases; a vector file is not a completed independent audit.
Record reviewer identity, independence, scope, revision, findings, and limitations. Author self-review is not an independent audit.
Only publish actual generated or independently derived vectors after the applicable approved work; no placeholder output may look like a passed vector.
Publish reproducible conditions, baselines, useful throughput, latency percentiles, overhead, and uncertainty; no benchmark has run at this stage.
